title: Top 8 Crypto Coins To Go ALL IN October 2026
summary: Crypto channel lists eight coins to get rich without luck, citing celebrity and institutional endorsements, and promotes an exchange's sign-up bonuses.

assertions.quote: Get rich in crypto without getting lucky. This is totally possible if you follow the right people.

verdicts.note: Influencer coin picks show no persistent skill, and many promoted tokens underperform after the promotion.

assertions.quote: Well, now a Google co-founder is talking about it.
Listen, I like Zcash, but I want to find the next Zcash.
The more people who watch, share, and engage with this video, the higher these coins go.

verdicts.note: Influencer attention can move tiny coins briefly, but it has no lasting effect on large caps like the ones listed, and the bumps tend to reverse.

assertions.quote: BlackRock is teaming up with Ondo to bring portfolios on chain. Like this is a reason to be bullish on Ondo.

verdicts.note: Partnerships rarely send value to a token's holders, and the news is usually priced in by the time it is announced.

assertions.quote: We are seeing Wall Street institutions, private companies building on Ethereum, launching on Ethereum, smart money accumulating Ethereum.
